test_title: PYST 10: SSC CHSL 2024 - English (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

(1) When Christy (2) grew out, (3) he turned out (4) to be a gentleman.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. this part of the sentence has an error.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the second part of the given sentence, the phrasal verb 'grew out' is incorrect.
 
• The correct phrasal verb should be 'grew up', which means to mature or to become an adult.
 
• Therefore, the phrasal verb 'grew up' should be used in place of the incorrect phrasal verb 'grew out'.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

Correct sentence: *When Christy **grew up**, he turned out to be a gentleman*.
